item.summary: The Department of Urban Development, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India, will organise the SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026 on 20 November 2026 at the Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi. The awards will be conferred by Shri Manohar Lal, Hon’ble Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs, in the presence of Shri Tokhan Sahu, Hon’ble Minister of State for Housing…
item.title: PM SVANidhi Samman Awards 2026 Recognise Excellence in Strengthening Street Vendors’ Livelihoods
